sources.claim: Taian Table — Shanghai's sole three-star Michelin restaurant

sources.title: 8½ Otto e Mezzo BOMBANA Shanghai
sources.claim: Two-star since the inaugural 2017 guide; chef Umberto Bombana's only Chinese mainland outpost

sources.title: Da Vittorio Shanghai
sources.claim: The Bergamo Cerea family's only Asian restaurant, ~¥3,000/person

sources.title: T'ang Court — The Langham Shanghai Xintiandi
sources.claim: Restored to two stars in the 2026 guide; premium Cantonese seafood and dim sum

sources.title: Bao Li Xuan — Bvlgari Hotel Shanghai
sources.claim: Two-star Cantonese restaurant in historic Shanghai Chamber of Commerce building

sources.title: Imperial Treasure Fine Chinese Cuisine
sources.claim: Two-star Cantonese, six consecutive years, ~¥400–500/person — best value

sources.title: Tou Zao — En Primeur Club
sources.claim: Newly promoted 2026 two-star; counter omakase; booked months ahead

sources.title: Amazing Chinese Cuisine — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: Promoted from one star in 2026; Chaoshan cuisine in five private rooms

sources.title: Fu He Hui — Rachel Gouk
sources.claim: Two-star vegetarian restaurant; set menus ¥580–¥880; Asia's 50 Best #19

sources.title: The House of Rong — En Primeur Club
sources.claim: Two-star Taizhou seafood in former I.M. Pei family mansion

sources.title: Michelin Guide Shanghai 2026 — Rachel Gouk
sources.claim: Full list of 2026 Michelin-starred restaurants; three new two-star promotions

sources.title: The Bund — China Footprints
sources.claim: Colonial waterfront facing Pudong skyline; sunset-to-blue-hour is the prime window

sources.title: Yu Garden — Travel China Guide
sources.claim: Ming-era classical garden in the Old City; ¥40 Apr–Jun; closed Mon

sources.title: Best Xiaolongbao in Shanghai — My Shanghai Guide
sources.claim: Jia Jia Tang Bao: family soup-dumpling legend since 1986, Bib Gourmand; pork-crab basket ~¥39

sources.title: Nanjing Road — Travel China Guide
sources.claim: ~1.2 km pedestrian shopping spine from People's Square to the Bund

sources.title: Wukang Road — Urban China Travelogue
sources.claim: ~2.5 km, 3–4 hr loop anchored by the triangular 1924 Wukang Mansion

sources.title: Xintiandi — Travel China Guide
sources.claim: Restored shikumen lane houses reborn as upscale dining and designer retail

sources.title: Shanghai Museum East — Official
sources.claim: New Pudong flagship for Chinese bronzes, ceramics, painting; free with ID

sources.title: Centre Pompidou × West Bund Museum — Official
sources.claim: France–China partnership renewed to ~2029; Reinventing Landscape runs through Oct 18, 2026

sources.title: Long Museum West Bund — Travel China Guide
sources.claim: Umbrella-arch concrete; ancient-to-contemporary span; free first Tuesday

sources.title: M50 Creative Park — Trip.com
sources.claim: 140+ galleries in old textile mills on Moganshan Road; free entry

sources.title: FLAIR Rooftop Bar — Official
sources.claim: Consensus #1 rooftop — 58F Ritz-Carlton Pudong, eye-level with Oriental Pearl

sources.title: Speak Low — World's 50 Best Bars
sources.claim: On World's 50 Best Bars every year since 2016; hidden behind a bar-tools shop

sources.title: Sober Company — World's 50 Best
sources.claim: Three-part venue from the Speak Low team; Chinese-ingredient cocktails

sources.title: Zhujiajiao Water Town — China Highlights
sources.claim: Metro Line 17 from Hongqiao, ~1 hr; no entrance fee; optional 8-attraction pass ¥60

sources.title: Shanghai–Suzhou High-Speed Train — Travel China Guide
sources.claim: Suzhou 25–45 min by high-speed train; ¥21–52 second class; 450+ daily departures

sources.title: Shanghai June Weather — Travel China Guide
sources.claim: June: 27°C, ~15 rainy days, 79% humidity — plum-rain season

sources.title: Best Time to Visit Shanghai — China Highlights
sources.claim: Spring (Apr–May) and autumn (Sep–Oct) are mildest and driest

sources.title: WAIC 2026 — World Artificial Intelligence Conference
sources.claim: China's flagship AI event; 800+ exhibitors, 70,000+ sqm; exhibition floor typically free

sources.title: AGNTCon + MCPCon China 2026 — LF Open Source
sources.claim: Sep 6–7; MCP co-founders, agent orchestration, MCP protocol development

sources.title: KubeCon + CloudNativeCon + PyTorch China 2026 — LF Open Source
sources.claim: Sep 8–9; rare four-community convergence: Kubernetes, OpenInfra, PyTorch, cloud-native AI

sources.title: MWC Shanghai 2026 — Official
sources.claim: Jun 24–26; Asia's largest connectivity event; 200+ exhibitors including Huawei, Alibaba, Lenovo
